source_note: Transcribed from the supplied Summer/Fall 2026 Motion Collection text extractions. Dimensions are H × W × D in inches as printed; extracted decimal glyphs appeared as a replacement mark in some dimensions and have been normalized to the visible source decimal fraction when unambiguous. Verify in current price books. Index flags are only collection categories, not complete orderability or compatibility evidence. No fit or capacity claims are inferred.
source_conflicts: The earlier supplied Summer/Fall 2026 Recliner Collection and its supplemental image index use different pagination and sometimes different category flags from this Motion Collection. This motion index is kept separate; for example Liam 786 appears on motion page 23 while the earlier recliner source places it on pages 35-36.
The motion table of contents prints Quinault 810 twice for page 30; both entries are retained in source_order as a duplicate printed row.
The table of contents places Ovation A86 after Bennett despite assigning it page 36; source_order follows the printed row order, while page remains 36.
The supplied Palmer 800 page-24 extraction labels the 44S/U4S/X4S armless-recliner rows with suffix 521 despite their position in the Palmer 800 table; retained as a source discrepancy.
Motion TOC lists Palmer as code 810 on pages 24-25, while supplied page style tables label it Palmer 800. Both entries are retained as source-specific facts.
Page-table extraction shows Acadia/Armitage corner code 8C0 (zero), while prefix definitions extraction renders 8CO (letter O); both searchable variants retained.
The motion TOC places Ovation A86 after Bennett but assigns it page 36; source order and page are preserved separately.

notes: The extraction shows columns for one and three years for recliner/motion groups and one, three, and five years for chairs; its bullet/column alignment is not reliable, so no term is assigned to an individual component.

One-year fabric cover warranty applies to seam failure, fabric separation and nap loss; cover warranty addresses manufacturing/material defects; natural leather markings are not defects. See the complete current written warranty.
